## Quarto

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
raw_set <- read_csv(
  "OECD_raw_v2.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

**簡單整理檔案裡面的label**

```{r}
country_lab <- c(
  AUS = "Australia", AUT = "Austria", BEL = "Belgium", BGR = "Bulgaria",
  CAN = "Canada", CHE = "Switzerland", CHL = "Chile", COL = "Colombia",
  CRI = "Costa Rica", CZE = "Czechia", DEU = "Germany", ESP = "Spain",
  EST = "Estonia", FRA = "France", GBR = "United Kingdom", GRC = "Greece",
  HUN = "Hungary", IRL = "Ireland", ISR = "Israel", ITA = "Italy",
  LTU = "Lithuania", LUX = "Luxembourg", LVA = "Latvia", MEX = "Mexico",
  NLD = "Netherlands", NOR = "Norway", NZL = "New Zealand", OECD = "OECD average",
  POL = "Poland", PRT = "Portugal", ROU = "Romania", SVK = "Slovak Republic",
  SVN = "Slovenia", SWE = "Sweden", USA = "United States"
)
```

```{r}
sex_lab   <- c("F" = "Female", "M" = "Male", "_T" = "Total")
age_lab   <- c("Y25T34" = "25-34", "Y35T44" = "35-44", "Y45T54" = "45-54",
               "Y55T64" = "55-64", "Y25T64" = "25-64 (all)")
edu_lab   <- c("ISCED11A_0T2" = "Below upper secondary",
               "ISCED11A_3_4" = "Upper secondary / post-secondary non-tertiary",
               "ISCED11A_5T8" = "Tertiary", "_T" = "All levels")
birth_lab <- c("FB" = "Foreign-born", "NB" = "Native-born", "_Z" = "Not applicable")
arrival_lab <- c("Y_LT16" = "Arrived before age 16",
                 "Y_GE16" = "Arrived at age 16 or older",
                 "_T" = "All arrival ages", "_Z" = "Not applicable")
status_lab <- c("A" = "Normal value", "U" = "Low reliability", "O" = "Missing value")

```

**為了讓資料更一目了然，我想要把國家依照區域分類**

```{r}
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data |>
  mutate(
    region = case_match(
      country,
      c("Canada", "United States") ~ "Northern America",
      c("Mexico", "Costa Rica", "Colombia", "Chile") ~ "Latin America",
      c("Australia", "New Zealand") ~ "Oceania",
      "Israel" ~ "Western Asia",
      c("Austria", "Belgium", "France", "Germany", "Luxembourg",
        "Netherlands", "Switzerland") ~ "Western Europe",
      c("Estonia", "Ireland", "Latvia", "Lithuania", "Norway",
        "Sweden", "United Kingdom") ~ "Northern Europe",
      c("Greece", "Italy", "Portugal", "Slovenia", "Spain") ~ "Southern Europe",
      c("Bulgaria", "Czechia", "Hungary", "Poland", "Romania",
        "Slovak Republic") ~ "Eastern Europe",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(region, .after = country)

```

```{r}
# Check:any country without a region? 
cleaned_data |>
filter(is.na(region)) |>
  distinct(country)
  
cleaned_data |>
  count(region)

write_excel_csv(cleaned_data, "cleaned_data.csv")
```

**接下來，我想要了解本地人跟外國人的失業率差距**

```{r}
native_born_data <- cleaned_data |>
  filter(birth_place == "Native-born") |>
  select(country, region, sex, age, education,
         native_born_rate = unemployment_rate_pct) #unemployment_rate_pct「失業者佔該子群體勞動力的百分比」

foreign_born_data <- cleaned_data |>
  filter(birth_place == "Foreign-born") |>
  select(country, region, sex, age, education, arrival_age,
         foreign_born_rate = unemployment_rate_pct)

```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  filter(region == "Northern Europe") |>
  group_by(birth_place) |>
  summarise(mean_unemployment_rate = mean(unemployment_rate_pct),
            n_rows = n())
```
